title: Minigame: B23.74 Factory

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the B23.74 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): board 1's nine-hex stone building X3, the Tractor Works' Factory, made a Factory by this card's SSR, its facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): what TEM and Factory Hindrance fire into the Factory meets, and what a step in it costs, asked on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: B23.741's example on board 1: a German squad inside the Factory X3 fires at a Russian squad in it, another fires from outside, and a mortar fires into it.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
